newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea 3-yr yields end up on tightening liquidity.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea 3-yr yields end up on tightening liquidity.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporates closed higher on Monday in weak trading as the tightening liquidity as a result of tax and salary payments towards the end of the month dampened the sentiment, brokers said.
Three-month CD yields also closed higher due to overall liquidity shortages, they said.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.48 pct from Friday's 12.30
* Average overnight call unchanged at 15.75 pct
Brokers said the three-year yields would rise further on Tuesday in the absence of fresh boosting factors.
They said new issues of corporate bonds were estimated at 173 billion won on Tuesday, compared with 154 billion today.
There would be about 2.9 trillion won worth of new issues in December, against this month's 3.1 trillion.
Three-month CD yields also closed higher due to the tight liquidity while the average overnight call rate remained unchanged, brokers said.
